member.summary: The namespace of the generated types, empty for no namespace

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.InputSuffix
member.summary: Appended to the base name for the input type

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.OutputSuffix
member.summary: Appended to the base name for the output type

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Properties
member.summary: Generate properties ({ get; set; }), false for fields

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Defaults
member.summary: Initialize the input members with the workflow defaults, false leaves them null (not sent, so the workflow default is used)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Nested
member.summary: Generate nested types for inputs with an object value (named the base name + the member name), false uses JsonElement?

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Comments
member.summary: Generate xml documentation comments (the node, the input and the workflow default)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.ShortNames
member.summary: Use the shortest member names that map unambiguously (ex: "Megapixels"), false includes the tag (ex: "ResolutionMegapixels")

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Explicit
member.summary: Map all members explicitly with [ComfyUiName("tag.input")], else only members that can't be mapped by name

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Bypass
member.summary: Generate a bool? member for each annotated node, setting it to false bypasses the node(s)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Casing
member.summary: How the member names are formatted: Pascal, Camel, Snake or Original

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.FileType
member.summary: The type of inputs that looks like a media file name (ex: the image of a "Load Image" node): ComfyUiFile, byte[], Uri or String

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.OutputType
member.summary: The type of the outputs: byte[] (the first result), byte[][] or List<byte[]> (all results), String, String[] or List<String> (base64)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.UiFolder
member.summary: Optional folder with UI format workflows (as saved by ComfyUI using "Workflow > Save"), the one with the same name as the API workflow is used to annotate the inputs of subgraphs

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsParams.Overwrite
member.summary: Overwrite existing .cs files, false skips them

member.name: F:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsProgram.ExitConvertFailed
member.summary: Exit code: one or more files couldn't be converted (not an API format workflow, invalid json etc), the others are converted.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsProgram.CleanTypeName(System.String)
member.summary: Clean up a file name to a type name: words (split at non letters / digits and lower to upper case changes) with the first letter in upper case and the rest in lower case, ex: "AUK_Text_2_speech" => "AukText2Speech", "my-workflow v2" => "MyWorkflowV2"

member.name: M:SysWeaver.ComfyApiToCsProgram.Main(System.String[])
member.summary: Process exit codes (from SysWeaver.CommandLine FilesToFolderTool), 0 = success, non-zero (1-255) = failure: 0 = success or help requested, 1 = an exception while processing, 2 = invalid command line, 3 = one or more files couldn't be converted.
